svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Pathway refinement
svg.desc: Four views of the same model energy surface: two molecular-dynamics snapshots relax to the reactant and product minima, an interpolated band of seven images relaxes onto the minimum-energy path, the highest image climbs to the saddle, and the saddle displaced both ways along its imaginary mode relaxes to both endpoints. A chart shows the energy of each image, with a barrier of 0.62 eV.
